column1: # Custom partition table for the Secure Boot demo.
# Why a custom table + a large partition-table offset (0xD000
# sdkconfig.defaults)?  Turning on Secure Boot makes the second-stage
# bootloader BIGGER (it now carries a 1216-byte signature block and secure
# padding). The bootloader lives between 0x2000 and the partition table
# push the partition table out to 0xD000 to leave the bootloader room to grow.
# Get this wrong and the signed bootloader overruns the partition table.
# Offsets are left blank so the generator auto-places each partition right
